title: jasione crispa subsp. tomentosa
intro: Jasione crispa subsp. tomentosa, commonly known as Woolly Bellflower, is a perennial plant belonging to the bellflower family (Campanulaceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its multiple health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Woolly Bellflower are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
